title: Article XI cooperating-path effect debt register
authority: Constitution Article XI temporary migration provision; HS-106-03
scope: Static effect-capable statements under holdspeak/ in the five ratified census families. Ignored source paths are included; bytecode, source maps, and vendored/generated static assets are excluded.
counting_rule: Count statements, not logical user actions. Every ambient boundary crossed by one action remains a separate site.
legal_effect: Bypass, mixed, and dormant entries are declared migration debt, not authority. Read and exempt_computation entries are explicitly triaged non-debt and grant no effect authority. No agent principal may reach a debt path named by this register. Covered entries record existing audited chokepoints and do not grant authority beyond those chokepoints.

status_definitions.covered: Every in-tree route reaches the statement through an audited chokepoint named by the census.
status_definitions.bypass: A reachable route avoids all named audited chokepoints.
status_definitions.mixed: Covered and bypass routes share this statement; treated as not covered.
status_definitions.dormant: No current production caller, but the ambient capability can execute without a named chokepoint; treated as not covered.
status_definitions.read: Effect-free information retrieval exempt from admission and receipts; authenticated principal and named read authority remain mandatory.
status_definitions.exempt_computation: Latency-sensitive model computation whose output returns to its caller; triaged explicitly, not migration debt.

sites.reason: Production transport invocation inside the audited coder_steering.deliver chokepoint; delivery-command traffic also carries its command receipt.
Production key transport invocation inside the audited coder_steering.deliver_keys chokepoint; delivery-command traffic adds its command receipt.

The sole remaining TextTyper caller executes only after desktop.type_text admission, an owner-direct-gesture warrant, immutable focus-generation verification, and before a paired native and kernel terminal receipt.
The fixed gh pr/issue view argv obtains metadata only; owner principal plus named gh read authority is required before the CLI runs.
The fixed jira issue view argv obtains ticket metadata only; owner principal plus named jira read authority is required before the CLI runs.
The bridge invokes only dw document views and gh PR receipt views; owner principal plus named dw/gh read authority keeps the conveyor cheap.
Custom-opener outbound dispatch is reached only through ActuatorExecutor and now carries manifest permission, destination scope, and data classes into external.egress admission.
Production webhook HTTP send is constructed and executed only through the audited actuator route.

Dictation intent classification is latency-sensitive model computation whose output returns to the hold-key caller; explicitly exempt under Article XI.5 and RFC section 12 even when its configured compute endpoint is remote.
The dictation classification compatibility retry has the same caller-returning, latency-sensitive computation contract as N10; explicitly exempt, never silently pattern-exempted.
Project-aware dictation rewrite returns text to the hold-key caller on the permanently low-latency path; explicitly exempt computation even when the configured model endpoint is remote.
TextTyper replaces the system clipboard as a desktop.type_text substep; retained until the whole typing operation executes under one warrant.
TextTyper presses paste modifiers as a raw keyboard substep; retained until the whole typing operation executes under one warrant.
TextTyper presses the paste key as a raw keyboard substep; retained until the whole typing operation executes under one warrant.
TextTyper releases the paste key as a raw keyboard substep; retained until the whole typing operation executes under one warrant.
TextTyper releases paste modifiers as a raw keyboard substep; retained until the whole typing operation executes under one warrant.
TextTyper restores the prior clipboard as a desktop.type_text substep; retained until the whole typing operation executes under one warrant.
TextTyper emits synthetic characters directly in its slow path; retained until desktop.type_text executes under one warrant.
TextTyper presses Enter directly when submission is requested; retained pending target-aware desktop.type_text or process.input admission.
TextTyper releases Enter directly as part of submission; retained pending target-aware desktop.type_text or process.input admission.
Dormant AppleScript helper can invoke osascript/System Events directly; retained only until the ambient helper is removed or brokered.
